title: RealtimeSignal v1 payload
description: ADR 0045. Something in a scope changed; the reader re-reads it through the ordinary authorized API. Identifiers, a scope key, and a time. additionalProperties is false so a field carrying state — an order total, a courier coordinate, a customer name — cannot be added without changing this file and being seen.

channel.description: A registered ADR 0045 stream channel. An unknown name is dropped by the consumer rather than failing it, because adding a channel must not be a coordinated deploy.

scope.description: The fan-out key and the Kafka record key: TENANT, BRAND, or LOCATION and a UUID. Never PLATFORM — a platform-wide stream would carry one tenant's changes to another tenant's screen.

version.description: The resource's version after the change, so a client holding a newer copy can drop the frame instead of re-reading. Null where the source has no version.
